walkthroughs.body_html:
Independent Research Project — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Independent Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Independent Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which is the correct reflexive: '___ casé en 2020'?
options: me
se
te
nos

mcqs.q: When was same-sex marriage legalised in Spain?
Which Spanish 'you' do you use with a stranger or elderly person?
options: Ustedes always.
Usted (formal singular).
De.
Tú (familiar singular).

mcqs.q: Why does 'inglés' have a written accent?
options: All Spanish words have accent marks.
It stresses the final syllable while ending in -s, which is unusual.
To distinguish it from 'ingles' (groins).
Ustedes always.

mcqs.q: What goes between 'veo' and 'mi amigo' in 'I see my friend'?
options: Personal 'a' - 'Veo A mi amigo'.
Nothing.
De.
To distinguish it from 'ingles' (groins).
